verdict.rationale: NVIDIA publishes 32 GB of GDDR7. Independent reviews corroborate 32 GB on a 512-bit bus with 1.792 TB/s bandwidth and 'potent AI performance', and fifth-gen Tensor Cores add FP4 support useful for quantized inference. However, nothing in the pack shows a 70B-class quantized model actually fitting or running practically on a single card, so the core of the story is only implied by specs. Missing for 10: evidence that a 70B quantized model fits in 32 GB, LLM inference benchmarks (tokens/s), first-party guidance on local LLM workloads.
